title: Local criterion of flatness modulo a nonzerodivisor
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)\subset\mathfrak m_B$) and let $M$ be a finitely generated $B$-module, regarded as an $A$-module via $\varphi$. Let $x\in\mathfrak m_A$ be a nonzerodivisor on $A$ such that multiplication by $x$ (that is, by $\varphi(x)$) on $M$ is injective. If $M/xM$ is a flat module over $A/xA$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $M$ is a flat $A$-module.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00ML (lemma-variant-local-criterion-flatness, line 23751) with $I=(x)$, together with the remark following it (for $I=(x)$, $x$ a nonzerodivisor on $R$: $\mathrm{Tor}_1^R(M,R/(x))=0$ iff $x$ is a nonzerodivisor on $M$) and Remark Tag 00M6 (remark-Tor-ring-mod-ideal); 00ML rests on Lemma Tag 00MK (lemma-local-criterion-flatness) and Lemma Tag 051C (lemma-what-does-it-mean)
